categories_thin: Retail shops (furniture, jewellery, florist, hardware, appliances, bikes, gifts): Piscataway retail is dominated by excluded big-box product (Walmart, Lowe's), so only about 18 independents were found. Searches for a bicycle shop, toy store and independent bookstore returned no seller inside Piscataway town limits.
Independent hotels: no independent Piscataway lodging was found; the town's hotels are chain product.
Self storage: every facility found (CubeSmart, Extra Space, SecureSpace, modSTORAGE) is a national or regional chain, so none were listed.
Funeral homes: only one Piscataway funeral home was found (Piscataway Funeral Home); the neighbouring market is served from South Plainfield, New Brunswick and Middlesex.

Bookstores: the only independent that surfaced markets itself as Piscataway (Cindelle's Bookstore) has Google reviews describing it as a Plainfield store beside Queen City Coffee Roasters, so its town could not be verified and it was not listed.

Group C trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, cleaning, pest, locksmiths, security) and group B services (medical, dental, salons, fitness, martial arts) are out of scope for this group-D zone and were not mapped - several of those categories are well populated in town and will need their own pass.
caveats: FOOD EXCLUSION: the exclusion was applied to food service (restaurants, cafes, bakeries, delis, grocers, butchers, liquor, convenience). Food MANUFACTURERS and WHOLESALERS were kept as group-D businesses - Snack Innovations, Thomas Foods, Ferraro Foods of New Jersey, Douglas Sales/Price Mark, Trans-Packers Services. A reviewer applying the food exclusion literally would strike them; they are manufacturing/distribution, not retail or delivery-app food.

FRANCHISE / CHAIN ENTRIES REMOVED from the list this revision, per the verifier: Signarama Piscataway (1312 W 7th St), Sir Speedy Piscataway (30 Knightsbridge Rd), SpeedPro Piscataway (56 Ethel Rd W), The Goddard School of Piscataway (376 S Randolphville Rd), The Learning Experience - Piscataway (1624 Stelton Rd), KinderCare Learning Center at Piscataway (659 Hoes Ln W), and Abbey Carpet Factory Outlets (501 Stelton Rd). Keep them in a separate franchise-bucket file if the owner wants franchisee-owned targets; they are excluded types for this deliverable.

WRONG-TOWN ENTRIES REMOVED: All Brands Furniture (696 Oak Tree Ave is South Plainfield, and the brand runs four NJ stores), J&M Furniture (175 Talmadge Rd is Edison; showrooms in Manhattan, Queens and Paramus), Pantagis Renaissance (Scotch Plains venue reported closed), My Framing Store (485 US Highway 1, Edison).

GOVERNMENT / CIVIC ENTRIES REMOVED: Raritan Landing Golf Course (Middlesex County facility); River Road Fire Company Banquet Hall (102 Netherwood Ave, volunteer fire company hall); North Stelton Banquet Hall (70 Haines Ave is the North Stelton Volunteer Fire Company address and the rental is run through T&L/Leon's Catering). All three are quasi-civic rather than independent SMB prospects.

K-12 PRIVATE SCHOOLS REMOVED: An-Noor Academy and Timothy Christian School. The zone brief covers group D childcare, tutoring and enrichment; K-12 schools are an excluded type here. Childcare centres and preschools remain in the list.

NO-ADDRESS ENTRIES DROPPED this revision until an address can be pinned to Piscataway: Roxy's Store, My Framing Store (also wrong town), P.A.W.S. University (advertises in-person training in the Piscataway/New Brunswick area with no street address), Paws & Bubbles (mobile grooming, no address), Central Jersey Abaya and Dresses, A1 STEM Academy (multi-town tutoring brand, no Piscataway address), NexGen Packaging (no Piscataway facility could be located this pass), Continental Precision Corp and Weston Machine Co (only unconfirmed directory addresses), Pantagis Renaissance (also wrong town/closed). Addresses were captured this revision for Harmony Jewelers (31 1/2 Wickley Ave), Agilex Fragrances (140 Centennial Ave) and Quality Sheet Metal and Welding (23 Clawson St), so those stay.

DUPLICATES MERGED: Design & Molding Svc folded into Montrose Molders Corp (25 Howard St); Helm New York folded into Helm US Chemical Corp (1110 Centennial Ave); S.S. White Aerospace folded into National Manufacturing (151 Old New Brunswick Rd); UniQ Prep folded into PALS Learning Center (1629 Stelton Rd) - that last pair are separate brands at one address, so confirm which one trades there.

ABOUT 45 ENTRIES (mostly manufacturers, wholesalers and machine shops drawn from NJ Business Directory, Cylex and D&B) carry a name, category and address only - no phone or website - and are marked 'one directory only'. The verifier's warning stands: run a second source (state registry or the company's own site) on each before any outreach. Spot checks this revision upgraded or removed several of them, but the long tail is still single-sourced.

Vivek Flowers (1410 Stelton Rd, confirmed on the company's own store-locator) is a roughly 25-store, multi-state flower and gift chain, so it was excluded as a regional chain rather than listed as an independent.
Group D overlaps group C for auto repair; four auto shops were included and flagged rather than dropped, since the town brief did not assign group C to another mapper.
Several NJ Business Directory listings look stale (e.g. Jevic Transportation, Sunoco Refining & Marketing, Raceway Petroleum) and were deliberately left out.

Site access: Yellow Pages, Superpages, Cylex, Manta, BBB, D&B, Angi and BizStanding return 403/Cloudflare blocks from this machine, so entries drawn from them rest on search-result snippets and are labelled accordingly.
data_gaps: Overpass/OpenStreetMap API was unreachable in this session - no OSM cross-check of shops was possible.
The Township of Piscataway publishes no loadable licensed-business or economic-development directory, so the municipality's own list could not be used.
Google Maps returned a limited, non-paginating result set (about 8 results per query), so map coverage per category remains partial.

Yahoo Local 'Piscataway' pages mix in businesses from a wide radius and often omit street addresses, so a number of Yahoo-only entries (Roxy's Store, Central Jersey Abaya, Paws & Bubbles) had to be dropped or left unaddressed.

Addresses for Agilex Fragrances and Quality Sheet Metal and Welding were taken from their own contact-page content as returned in search results; the pages themselves are script-rendered and would not render the address in the fetch tool, so confirm by phone.

Cindelle's Bookstore could not be confirmed inside Piscataway: the indie-bookshop directory lists it as Piscataway, but customer reviews on that same page describe it as a Plainfield store next to Queen City Coffee Roasters and mention 1741 W 3rd Street. Left unlisted pending a town check.

NexGen Packaging, Continental Precision Corp and Weston Machine Co could not be given a verified Piscataway street address this pass (D&B and allpages pages are blocked), so they are held out of the list rather than guessed.

Piscataway's martial-arts schools (Kaizen, Thaxton, Satori Academy, Master Yu's), salons, dentists and other group A/B businesses surfaced during searching but are outside this group-D zone and were not mapped.
Roughly 45 single-directory manufacturers/wholesalers still lack a second source and any phone or website.
